about: Landmarks on the leather chest sheet (tools/sculpt/ref/leather-chest.png, 1536 x 1024 px), read off at 3x: per body and view, the elbows (the arm's middle where the base sleeve ends, just under the elbow's bend) and wrists (the wrist band's middle) as [x, y], the neck's middle across (the collar's middle, x only); 'l' and 'r' the figure's own left and right. Views are the sheet's turns: front 0, q3 45 (the right side toward us), side 270 (the left side), r3 225 (the left side and the back), back 180.
